dek: 70 proposals from the Mandate for Leadership’s 30 chapters, each with what the administration did about it, when, who did it and where we read it. Judged against what stands today.
method: The first sprint scored the proposals that changed the most lives or the most law, drawing its sources from seven research passes on Nov. 8, 2026. “Done” means carried out and in force; “in progress” means under way; “partial” means done in part or in a weaker form; “blocked by courts” means an injunction or ruling is in force against it; “reversed” means done and undone; “not attempted” means not tried. Items marked beyond the Mandate are things the administration did that the book did not ask for. Later sprints add chapters the first did not reach (see SPRINTS.md).

meta.method: Statuses assigned from sources fetched in this session (project2025.observer agency/objective pages, FactCheck.org Project 2025 series, PBS/The 19th, CPR tracker, SCOTUSblog, CRS, Ballotpedia, OPM, Wikipedia topic pages, law-firm client alerts). Sources marked 'verified' were seen only in search results or citation lists and not opened. Web-search budget was exhausted mid-sprint; gaps are flagged in each item's note.
